environment: Real storage-backed TradingEnv; no adapter injection or preflight bypass

definitions.history: Last up to 5 market close records available at as_of, in availability order. Available pre-episode records are included. lookback_used counts close records; adjacent returns number lookback_used minus 1.
definitions.mean_return: Arithmetic mean of adjacent close-to-close simple returns.
definitions.missing: Fewer than 2 visible close records: all 3 metrics are null, not zero.
definitions.units: Returns and volatility are fractions, not percentages, and not annualized. These describe visible history, not future returns.
definitions.volatility: Population standard deviation (ddof=0) of those returns.
